summary.added_external_crate_count_note: P2-N6 admits no external crate. academic-critical-path links academic-curriculum, academic-domain, academic-freshness, academic-gap, serde and thiserror as product edges, and academic-capture, academic-consent, academic-knowledge-state, academic-lecture-document, academic-model-run, academic-policy, academic-repository, academic-repository-analysis, academic-repository-classification, academic-repository-correlation, academic-transcription, academic-untrusted-content, serde_json, tempfile, trybuild and uuid as dev edges, all covered by earlier reviewed receipts, and adds one workspace path package. Nothing links into a product binary that was not already there: the four workspace product edges are path packages this repository already builds, and serde and thiserror were admitted by the phase 1 receipt. Build-time-only additions are zero -- there is no build script, no proc macro beyond serde's and thiserror's, and no code generator. The one example target, emit_corpus, is compiled with dev-dependencies and ships in no product build.
summary.added_workspace_path_package_note: academic-critical-path is the P2-N6 boundary: section 16's typed prerequisite hypergraph with AND/OR branches, the seven-component cost vector and five-component benefit vector that are never folded into a scalar, Pareto elimination before any preference, the eight named constraints of section 16.3, the counterfactual preview of every relation, the user relation edit that recomputes while preserving the base, and the five disclosure groups section 16.5 requires on every answer. It is a separate package from academic-gap because the restraint section 16.5 demands is then a graph fact rather than a rule: nothing in that crate ranks anything, and nothing here produces a GapCase. It is a separate package from academic-domain because it reads P2-N5's case, P2-N3's band and P2-U1's offering standing, all of which academic-domain sits below and cannot depend on without a cycle. It registers no thirteenth deterministic engine: section 28's table has twelve rows, the P2-C5 registry is pinned to that table as an enumeration, and none of the twelve is a critical path engine, so this crate claims no engine_id and adds nothing under testdata/engines/.

no_second_ladder_note: Section 7.2's twenty predicates and the prerequisite column that says which two a path engine may traverse were fixed by P2-C1's predicate registry, and this crate declares no second allowlist: a hyperedge member is an academic_gap::PrerequisiteEdge, which passed that crate's admit and therefore prerequisite_descriptor, so eighteen of the twenty including RELATED_TO have no value of that type at all. Section 8.3's four CourseOffering standings were fixed by P2-U1 and constraint two reads OfferingStatus rather than restating them; Credits, Meeting and Weekday are that crate's too. Section 13.3's six freshness bands were fixed by P2-C1 and constraint seven is a total match over them with no wildcard arm, naming exactly the STALE band and deliberately not UNKNOWN, which P2-N3's own module note calls the band for a concept about which nothing datable was ever admitted. Section 28's twelve deterministic engines were fixed by P2-C5 and this crate adds no thirteenth: the_registry_does_not_hold_a_critical_path_engine asserts that section 28 still tabulates twelve, that its table names no critical path engine, that ENGINE_REGISTRY still holds twelve entries, that this crate's corpus label is not a registry name, and that nothing of this crate's sits under the registry's harness root. The five counts section 16 fixes -- seven cost axes, five benefit axes, eight constraints, five disclosure groups, four path roles -- are each measured against the design document in both directions rather than restated as numbers, and two readings the document leaves open are recorded with tests that fail when it stops saying so: section 16.2 introduces its four strategy names with 같은, which is such as, and section 16.3's eighth bullet is itself the diagnostic-checkpoint rule that t068 names as a separate acceptance row.

direct_workspace_dependencies.academic-curriculum: OfferingStatus, Credits, Meeting and Weekday. Section 16.3's second and third constraints are about a CourseOffering's confirmation standing, its official prerequisites, its meetings and its credits, and all four are that crate's types. The edge is what keeps section 36.7's do not confuse an official course with an offering's actual coverage a structural fact: HistoricallyLikely and Uncertain reach ConstraintVerdict::Unknown rather than a pass, because they are not Confirmed and this crate reads that enumeration rather than declaring a second one. What the edge does not bring is the registrar's own prerequisite verdict: section 28's OFFICIAL_PREREQUISITE engine is PLANNED, so OfficialPrerequisiteStanding carries an Unknown value and folding it into Met is refused by name.
direct_workspace_dependencies.academic-domain: EntityId, EvidenceId, OfferingId, ContentDigest, FreshnessBand, Decimal, DomainError, and the whole P2-C5 harness module -- FrozenInputs, InputKey, InputValue, ProofNode, ProofStatus, NodeId, RuleId, EngineResult, EngineOutcome, EngineError. The harness is why determinism here is a byte comparison rather than an absence of errors: frozen_inputs renders a run's identity into that crate's canonical key=value encoding with an unmeasured cost basis as unknown rather than a zero, and outcome renders the answer into that crate's proof tree and normalized explanation. FreshnessBand is P2-C1's and constraint seven is a total match over its six values.
direct_workspace_dependencies.academic-freshness: The P2-N3 boundary that produces the bands section 16.3's seventh constraint reads. This crate computes no band and holds no threshold of its own: which concept is stale is that crate's enumeration, read through a total match with no wildcard arm.
direct_workspace_dependencies.academic-gap: GapCase, GapError, PrerequisiteEdge. The input this engine plans around is P2-N5's case rather than a concept and a state, which is what carries section 15.1's restraint forward: a plan with no evidence-backed prerequisite deficit behind it has no value to be called with, because PlanRequest's first field is a &GapCase and academic_gap::search is the only producer of one. PrerequisiteEdge is the admitted section 7.2 edge a hyperedge member is built from, so the two engines descend the same edges and this crate holds no allowlist. The misattribution P2-N2, P2-N3 and P2-N5 each closed one hop further out arrives here already refused; what this crate adds is its own boundary of the same shape, NoEstimateForConcept, which refuses a satisfying set reaching a concept with no estimate rather than borrowing a neighbour's.

dev_workspace_dependencies.academic-capture: P2-L2's begin, its journal and its preflight readings, reached through P2-N2's fixture module by way of P2-N5's, so the manifest a document is built over is the file the real capture surface wrote.
dev_workspace_dependencies.academic-consent: P2-L2's consent ledger, capture request and permission scope, because a capture that is not permitted writes no journal and the fixture must pass the same gate a real one does.
dev_workspace_dependencies.academic-knowledge-state: The P2-N2 types P2-N5's fixture chain needs to build an admitted EligibleEvidence, reached through that crate's own common module by #[path].
dev_workspace_dependencies.academic-lecture-document: LectureDocument and NodeId, so the exposure evidence behind this suite's GapCase is a node of a document P2-L4 produced rather than a string this suite invented.
dev_workspace_dependencies.academic-model-run: CalibrationRegistry and its dataset types, which P2-L3's confidence interpretation requires before a segment exists.
dev_workspace_dependencies.academic-policy: ContentDigest, for the analysis policy hash a P2-R1 snapshot request carries.
dev_workspace_dependencies.academic-repository: P2-R1's capture_local and SnapshotRequest, reached through P2-N2's fixture module.
dev_workspace_dependencies.academic-repository-analysis: P2-R2's EvidenceLadder and Finding, reached through the same module.
dev_workspace_dependencies.academic-repository-classification: P2-R4's ConceptStance, which P2-N2's fixture module reads.
dev_workspace_dependencies.academic-repository-correlation: P2-R3's correlate, the only route from findings to the relation edges P2-R4 reads.
dev_workspace_dependencies.academic-transcription: P2-L3's run, its provider contract and its transcript lineage, so a document node maps a segment of a real transcript.
dev_workspace_dependencies.academic-untrusted-content: SourceIndex, which P2-R1's capture_local returns and P2-R2's AnalysisInput::of checks every unit against.
dev_workspace_dependencies.serde_json: course_is_an_acquisition_option. An Opportunity is driven through a real encoder and its field set is compared against the three an occasion has, so a mastery or a confidence added to it would fail rather than pass unnoticed.
dev_workspace_dependencies.tempfile: The directory a P2-L2 journal is written to, reached through P2-N5's fixture module. It is a dev edge only; no product file of this crate names it or any other filesystem type.
dev_workspace_dependencies.trybuild: The compile-fail suite. Section 16's limits are types, and the eight cases under crates/critical-path/tests/compile_fail assert that each refusal is a program that does not compile with a committed diagnostic: a vector edited where it stands, a vector compared as a whole, a ranking mutating its front, a front assembled without elimination, a disclosure assembled with a group missing, a slider with a default, a course yielding a mastery, and an estimate read as a point. The cases live in this package rather than in academic-scenario's suite for the reason P2-N2 gives: this crate reaches academic-knowledge-state, which reaches academic-ledger, and scenario_crate_has_no_writer_dependency refuses academic-scenario that crate through a dev edge as much as a product one.
dev_workspace_dependencies.uuid: Deterministic UUIDv7-shaped fixture identities, reached through P2-N5's fixture module. Every identifier in the suite is a SHA-256 of the fixture's own name with the version and variant nibbles set, so no identity is a function of a clock.

why_this_dependency_belongs_inside_its_t: academic-critical-path is a workspace path crate, not an external dependency. It owns section 16's critical path engine and, for each rule, the value that does not exist rather than the check somebody has to remember to run: CostVector and BenefitVector have private fields, one accessor per named axis, and no total, sum, score, weighted, Ord, PartialOrd or numeric conversion, so a vector cannot be folded into a recommendation score; CostEstimate hands out low and high and nothing between them and refuses an unmeasured estimate whose ends are equal, so no route can fold to a point estimate; ParetoFront::eliminate is the only constructor of a front and rank takes nothing else, so section 16.2's 먼저 is a type rather than a comment; PreferenceSlider is a complete permutation of all twelve axes with no Default and no arithmetic combining two axes, and Ranking borrows its front through a shared reference with no interior mutability anywhere in the crate, so a slider physically cannot reach a fact; AcquisitionOption hands out occasions and has no function returning a mastery, a state or a satisfied concept, so taking a course changes no knowledge state; constraint::evaluate returns a fixed-size array of eight findings with no filter and no Option, so a plan cannot be produced with a constraint unanswered; and Disclosure has five private fields taken by one constructor with no Default, held by value on the result, so an answer with a group missing is not a value this crate can produce. Its dependency set is minimal and the edges it does not have are the point: no academic-store, so no plan reaches the canonical writer and no migration is added; no academic-worker and no academic-egress-boundary as direct edges, so no product file here can launch a process or stage a payload; and no academic-model-run as a product edge, so nothing in the product path can call a model.
network_posture: The crate opens no socket, opens no file, reads no clock, declares no foreign function, reads no environment variable, spawns no process, and runs no build script. It spells no std::fs, std::net, std::process, std::env or std::time name at all: every instant arrives as a caller-supplied day count or inside a P2-N3 value. the_vectors_cannot_be_folded, the_preference_layer_cannot_reach_a_vector and no_clock_socket_or_file_reaches_this_crate in crates/critical-path/tests/critical_path_scans.rs compare the whole set of its 75 use items, the whole set of the 16 two-segment paths it reaches through a crate root, the whole set of the 3 macros it invokes and the 13 modules lib.rs re-exports from against pinned inventories in both directions, refuse twelve folding spellings and eight interior-mutability spellings over every product file as whole identifiers, compare in both directions the set of modules that produce an ordering at all, and run a whole-identifier pass for fifteen filesystem, clock, process and transport constructs. the_package_has_no_unscanned_directory compares the package root's own listing against the two directories the product walk excludes, so a build script added later is a failure rather than unscanned source. Sixteen injections that spell none of the forbidden tokens were each compiled and each observed failing a named test. Its link closure holds nothing that can open a socket beyond libc, which reaches it through academic-policy by way of academic-knowledge-state. Every document, capture, transcript, snapshot, claim, projection and gap case in its test tree is synthetic and built in process; no real lecture or repository is read and no network call is made.
advisory_path: Unchanged. Every external crate academic-critical-path links was admitted by an earlier receipt and is triaged through that receipt's advisory path. serde and thiserror were admitted by the phase 1 receipt; serde_json, tempfile, trybuild and uuid are already-admitted dev dependencies of other workspace packages. .github/dependabot.yml opens no version-update pull request.
